ideas.name: Twin-Track Scripted Synthesis (TSS)
ideas.one_liner: One event script renders synchronized video and audio tracks so every crossmodal AND question has exact compositional ground truth by construction, with counterfactual edits applied to a single modality component at a time (change video only -> answer must flip/stay), for decision-LoRA training.

novelty.claim: Synthetic AVQA datasets exist (Tsinghua AVQA 2022, templated) but are open-loop dataset construction; single-script dual-track rendering with per-modality counterfactual control and exact compositional truth for decision-token training not found in retrieval.

nearest_neighbors.difference: synthetic templated AVQA but no counterfactual component control, no decision-token training, open-loop

nearest_neighbors.name: MUSIC-AVQA
nearest_neighbors.difference: real data, no control over composition truth

nearest_neighbors.name: AGQA
nearest_neighbors.difference: single-modality video program generation

search_terms: synthetic audio-visual question answering generation simulation SoundSpaces paired audio video training data -> no dual-track counterfactual decision-training hit

ideas.gain_mechanism: exact AND truth enables 001-I1 factorized targets and II-5 sub-decision supervision; per-modality edits teach which component decides the answer (executable version of 001-I9 equivariance)

gain_estimate.basis: modality-bias correction literature scale; main uncertainty is sim-to-real transfer

contract.notes: data-side; simulator + simple DSP event synthesis, no generative-model dependency or license risk; render/DSP pipeline deps to be listed per AGENTS new-dependency rule

pilot.cpu_verifiable: 1-2k dual-track samples covering AND composition and counterfactual edits; zero-GPU fallback: build a counterfactual-consistency eval set first and measure current model's component-dependence bias (pure evaluation, no training)
pilot.design: SFT with 30% synthetic mix; eval crossmodal dev + real-distribution slices (sim2real check)

gates.success: crossmodal dev +2pt or ECE <=0.18 with no text/screenshot regression
gates.abandon: zero gain on real-distribution slices (sim2real broken) OR counterfactual eval shows components already correct (problem is not composition)

risks: synthetic-real domain gap (domain-randomized render params, real data dominates mix)
audio DSP fidelity (event sounds only, exclude speech)

ideas.name: Sub-Decision Auxiliary Supervision (SAS)
ideas.one_liner: Programmatically decompose crossmodal AND questions into modality sub-questions and supervise them as auxiliary training tasks for the same decision LoRA; inference remains single-forward single-token, decomposition exists only at training time.

novelty.claim: All decomposition precedents are inference-time multi-step pipelines (zero-shot VQA decomposition NeurIPS 2023, Successive Prompting, AGQA-Decomp at eval); training-time auxiliary decomposition supervision with single-forward inference and no CoT found no direct precedent (search summary itself flagged the combination as possibly new).

nearest_neighbors.difference: modality-subset INPUT distillation, not question decomposition

ideas.name: Program-Key kNN Decision Interpolation (PKI)
ideas.one_liner: Datastore over TRAIN pool keyed by (question embedding + program-structure encoding + modality/task type) with gold/teacher option distributions as values; at inference interpolate retrieved distributions with the single-token readout, lambda conditioned on (neighbor distance, neighbor agreement, candidate entropy) fit on the calibration split.

novelty.claim: Components have precedent (kNN-Prompt does neighbor label distributions for zero-shot MCQ; Drozdov conditions lambda on retrieval distance); the combination typed-decision x program-structure keys x calibration-fit lambda with disagreement features not found.

contract.notes: adds ANN retrieval dependency at inference (vLLM sidecar, ms-level latency but changes serving shape); training untouched

ideas.name: Twin Cascade with U port (TCU)
ideas.dimension: routing (engineering quick win, NOT claimed as paradigm)
ideas.one_liner: Candidate-first serving; its single-token readout entropy, jointly calibrated against (candidate, base, gold) outcomes on the calibration split (UEC-isomorphic), routes three ways: keep candidate / escalate to frozen base / emit U; escalation only on high-uncertainty tail.

novelty.claim: Mechanism is NOT new (TRIAGE UEC, UCCI, FrugalGPT lineage); our unique assets are the twin same-weights-minus-adapter structure (no style jump on escalation), U as a first-class routing port, and measured complementarity anchors (ambiguous base 5/7 vs candidate 2/7; oracle 81.8%).
